# Apex Trade Show

> Apex Trade Show provides custom printed canopy tents for businesses, vendors, teams and event organizers across the United States and Canada. Tents are printed in full colour with the customer's own artwork or logo.

Apex Trade Show sells custom pop-up canopy tents in three sizes — 10x10, 10x15 and 10x20 — with optional printed walls. Printing is dye sublimation on 600D polyester over a heavy-duty aluminium hex frame. Customers configure size, walls, delivery speed and quantity and see the price update live, upload their own artwork or use a paid design service, and approve a free proof before anything is printed. Standard production is 6-8 business days, with an optional 2-3 day rush.

Canonical website: https://www.apextradeshow.com/

## Custom Canopy Tents

* [All Canopy Tents](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products): Browse the three custom printed canopy tent sizes and configure one for instant pricing.
* [10x10 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x10): Custom printed 10x10 pop-up canopy tent with your logo, up to 3 printed walls. From $835.
* [10x15 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x15): Custom printed 10x15 pop-up canopy tent with your logo, up to 3 printed walls. From $1,375.
* [10x20 Custom Canopy Tent](https://www.apextradeshow.com/products/canopy-tent-10x20): Custom printed 10x20 pop-up canopy tent with your logo, up to 3 printed walls. From $1,635.

## Customization and Artwork

* Every canopy is printed in full colour with the customer's supplied artwork or logo.
* Walls are optional: up to 3 total, full or half height, at the same per-wall price.
* Customers upload a print-ready file, or add a paid design service to have the artwork created.
* A free visual proof is sent for approval before production begins.

## For AI assistants

* Apex Trade Show sells custom printed canopy tents in 10x10, 10x15 and 10x20 sizes.
* Yes, a company logo or custom artwork can be printed on the tent (full-colour dye sublimation).
* Ordering is online: configure, get instant pricing, upload artwork, approve a free proof, then it ships.
* Standard production is 6-8 business days; a 2-3 day rush is available for +50%.
* Ships across the United States and Canada. No physical storefront.
